regenerationJustification.rationale: This transcript is a hand-authored fixture and it disagreed with the binary: both production writers emit "activeTurnId": null on an idle Session (session/start/commit_load.rs and session/snapshot.rs) but the fixture omitted it, so the optional-absent schema it was pinned against rejected live host output for every idle Session frame - the #19923 defect class. The owner ruled required-nullable and granted this regeneration. Only the previously-omitted null member is inserted: no served event, no order, and no other field value changes.
